AUTHORITY: PRIMARY OFFICIAL
SOURCE: amended_irr_bp_344_official_gazette_2.pdf | pages 54-56 | Appendix A, 8. Elevators
CANONICAL FACTS:
- Accessible elevators shall be located not more than 30 meters from the entrance and shall be easy to locate with directional signs.
- Accessible elevator cars shall have a minimum clear dimension of 1400 mm in depth and 1200 mm in width, with a clear door opening of not less than 900 mm.
- Handrails shall be provided at 900 mm above the finished floor and fixed on both sides and at the rear of the elevator. If not continuous, the gap shall be 150 mm or less.
- The Accessible Elevator Car Operating Panel (COP) shall be installed at 900 mm on center from the floor.
- All elevator control buttons, including call and emergency buttons, shall have Braille installed at the left of the buttons and shall also have tactile buttons.
- Floor level indicators in Braille shall be installed at 1200 mm above the finished floor on both side jambs of the elevator door.
- Elevator control panel buttons shall have a minimum diameter of 20 mm and a maximum depression depth of 1 mm.
- Accessible elevators shall have a homing or emergency rescue device, voice synthesizers, and audio-visual indicators for emergencies.
- Accessible elevators shall provide an emergency two-way visual communication system using an audio-visual and text-based or video-based interactive system with audio, visual, and tactile controls.
- Elevator lobbies shall have a minimum clear space of at least 1800 mm x 1800 mm. Through-type elevators shall be used when possible.
USE RULES:
- Treat these values as the controlling BP 344 (2024 IRR) elevator dimensions and control-panel requirements unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL source in the provided context clearly supersedes them.
- If a topic mentions wheelchair turning, ground it in the cited elevator car clear dimensions and the 1800 mm x 1800 mm lobby clear space unless another PRIMARY OFFICIAL source gives a separate turning metric.
